related.title: 水力發電調速器與水錘模擬
related.titleEn: Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling
related.transfer: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「水泵斷電的過渡過程」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；水力發電調速器與水錘模擬的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "The pump power-failure transient" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦可逆式機組四象限特性與各種模式轉換的過渡過程；水力發電調速器與水錘模擬則以水流慣性、機組慣性與調速器參數的穩定配合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on four-quadrant characteristics of reversible units and the transients of each mode change; Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling centres on stable matching of water inertia, unit inertia and governor settings, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「四象限特性與運轉工況區」與「水流慣性時間常數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「變速機組與抽水調節」的模型移到水力發電調速器與水錘模擬，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「特徵線法模擬的時間步長」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Four-quadrant characteristics and operating regions" and "Water starting time".
Move the model of "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" to Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time step in method-of-characteristics simulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「水泵斷電的過渡過程」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；水力發電調速器與水錘模擬的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "The pump power-failure transient" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hydropower Governors and Water Hammer Modeling must be respecified.

related.title: 明潭抽蓄水力發電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「水泵斷電的過渡過程」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；明潭抽蓄水力發電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "The pump power-failure transient" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦可逆式機組四象限特性與各種模式轉換的過渡過程；明潭抽蓄水力發電廠則以以日月潭為上池的 1,602 MW 抽蓄電廠與運轉型態的轉變為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on four-quadrant characteristics of reversible units and the transients of each mode change; Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant centres on A 1,602 MW pumped-storage plant using Sun Moon Lake as upper reservoir, and its changing duty, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「四象限特性與運轉工況區」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「變速機組與抽水調節」的模型移到明潭抽蓄水力發電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模式切換與快速反應」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Four-quadrant characteristics and operating regions" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" to Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Mode changes and fast response", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「水泵斷電的過渡過程」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；明潭抽蓄水力發電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "The pump power-failure transient" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Mingtan Pumped Storage Power Plant must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 可逆抽蓄機組模式切換
history.text: 1930s：最早的可逆式水泵水輪機在歐洲與美國出現；1978 年浣熊山電站投產；1990 年日本矢木澤電站改裝首台大型變速機組；2010s：不同步導葉成為解決 S 形區問題的常用手段。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1930s: The first reversible pump-turbines appeared in Europe and the United States. 1978: Raccoon Mountain entered service. 1990: Japan's Yagisawa plant was retrofitted with the first large variable-speed unit. 2010s: Misaligned guide vanes became a common remedy for S-zone problems. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
